tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description starts with 'Use for AWS Systems Manager Automation tasks' which is imperative phrasing directing the agent. It lists concrete trigger contexts (unreachable EC2 instance, missing SSM node, public S3 bucket, Config finding, execution failures/approvals, runbook security review) and focuses on user goals (finding runbooks, preparing safe starts, explaining failures, reviewing security) rather than internal implementation. It is concise, a few sentences long.
tests.evidence: Use for AWS Systems Manager Automation tasks. Find an AWS-owned or account-owned runbook for an operational problem such as an unreachable EC2 instance, a node missing from Systems Manager, a public S3 bucket or a Config finding; prepare a safe start with rate control and a stopping alarm; explain why an execution failed, was cancelled or is waiting for approval; or review a runbook for security problems.
